int_name: N FRANKLIN ST & VINE STREET EXPY RAMP 8061E

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is extremely hostile, consisting of a vast, unmarked asphalt intersection beneath a highway overpass. There is a complete absence of basic safety features such as crosswalks, pedestrian signals, or continuous sidewalks, while large structural pillars create significant blind spots.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crossings
hazards.description: No designated paths for pedestrians to cross the wide intersection.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the entire foreground and middle ground pavement.

hazards.name: Excessive crossing distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross a very wide expanse of roadway without any refuge.
hazards.location_in_image: The main roadway area under the overpass.

hazards.name: Visual obstructions
hazards.description: Large concrete pillars supporting the overpass block sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Center and left-center of the image.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install zebra-striped crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian paths.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers at all crossing points.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Islands
interventions.description: Construct raised islands to break up the long crossing distance and provide a safe waiting area.

result.summary: The environment is a high-speed highway interchange area with a complete lack of pedestrian infrastructure. There are no sidewalks, marked crossings, or signals, making it extremely hostile for anyone on foot.

hazards.description: Complete absence of sidewalks and marked crossings in a high-speed vehicle environment.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance

interventions.title: Install Sidewalks and Crosswalks
interventions.description: Provide dedicated space for pedestrians and clearly marked paths across the roadway to separate modes.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is dominated by a wide, multi-lane roadway passing under a bridge with no visible marked crossings or pedestrian signals. While a sidewalk is present on the right side, the lack of crossing infrastructure and potential sightline issues created by the bridge structure make it a hostile environment for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a designated or protected path.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and under the bridge

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: The bridge abutments and dark underpass area limit visibility between drivers and pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Bridge structure and shadows

hazards.name: Wide Roadway
hazards.description: The large number of lanes increases exposure time for anyone attempting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Entire roadway width

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install marked crosswalks with high-visibility continental patterns to define pedestrian paths.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Lighting
interventions.description: Improve lighting under the bridge and at potential crossing points to increase visibility of pedestrians.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to reduce the crossing distance and improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.
